 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE JASMEET SINGH  ORDER % 20.01.2023
This is a petition seeking quashing of FIR No. 153/2019 dated 03.05.2019, under Sections 420/467/468/471/120-B/34 IPC, registered at Police Station-Keshav Puram, North-West District.

It is stated by Mr Yogesh Kumar, learned counsel appearing for the petitioner that in the present case, the petitioner/accused has arrived at a settlement before the Delhi Mediation Centre, Rohini District Court, Delhi on 30.09.2019 and the complainant has agreed to withdraw his complaint as well as cooperate in quashing of the FIR.

entities.text: Delhi Mediation Centre, Rohini District Court, Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: However, the complainant is not present in Court.
Mr Singh, learned APP accepts notice on behalf of the State.

Issue notice to the respondent No.2 by all modes including electronic on the petitioner taking requisite steps within one week from today,
returnable on 06.04.2023.
The notice shall indicate that the respondent No.2 is required to appear either in person or through video conferencing on the next date of hearing.
In the meanwhile, the respondent No.1 shall also file a status report indicating if there are any other persons who have been similarly cheated following the same modus operandi.
Let a status report be filed within four weeks.
